messages:
carl-partnerships: Quick sync — we need to lock the press window optics and demo reservations for the upcoming HW push. Targeting vendor demos for H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi + 1 marketplace showcase. Proposed timeline: internal dry-run Sep 21-23, partner-facing demos Sep 25-26. Any irreconcilable conflicts?

nina-hw: heads-up — MI300 has a firmware freeze window starting Sep 24. we can do early MI300 demos but swapping firmware after 24 will be risky. also Gaudi drivers need the new kernel image (6.2) for perf profiles.

sam-ops: lab capacity check: we have 3 bench clusters. current free slots:
```
bench-a (H100 x4): Sep 21 AM, Sep 22 AM
bench-b (Gaudi x6): Sep 21 PM, Sep 23 AM
bench-c (MI300 x2): Sep 21 AM only
```
If you want multi-vendor parallel demos we need to stagger across the two days.

mia-devex: I can own the demo templates + short howto for SIs. will prep a 10-min runbook and a short checklist for speakers. can we get final SKU list by EOD tomorrow? :calendar:

kevin-sales: Marketing needs embargo windows by Tuesday COB. also asking for a clean list of 'hero' demos for press kit — ideally 3: one generative, one retrieval, one embedding scale.

carl-partnerships: Agreed on hero picks. Proposal: H100 gen demo (low latency chat), MI300 embedding scale, Gaudi cost-of-inference compare. If H100 slot blows up we fallback to a dedicated cloud-hosted H100 instance (no hardware swap) — call that plan B.

nina-hw: Plan B OK but note: hosted H100 will increase networking latency vs lab; call it out to marketing. Also I'm pushing an updated lab image with kernel 6.2 and gaudi drivers — tag will be `lab-img:gaudi-6.2-20240915`. Use that for any Gaudi runs.

sam-ops: Reserve command (run once we agree):
```
reserve-lab --bench bench-a --sku H100 --start 2024-09-21T09:00 --end 2024-09-21T12:00 --owner carl
reserve-lab --bench bench-b --sku Gaudi --start 2024-09-21T13:00 --end 2024-09-21T16:00 --owner carl
reserve-lab --bench bench-c --sku MI300 --start 2024-09-21T09:00 --end 2024-09-21T11:00 --owner carl
```
I'll run these once we lock the hero list.

kevin-sales: tagging @marketing-leads — need final hero descriptions + short bullet on tradeoffs (latency vs cost) for each demo. also confirm embargo: proposed public announce 2024-09-27 10:00 PT, press embargo until 2024-09-27 10:00 PT. any objections?

carl-partnerships: no objections. Nina — can you confirm MI300 firmware freeze means no public-facing firmware toggles after 9/24? want to avoid last-minute perf regressions.

nina-hw: correct. No firmware changes after 9/24 without explicit signoff. Any perf regressions after that need rollback to known-good image.

mia-devex: I'll draft the runbook and sample prompts for the H100 demo (low-latency) and MI300 throughput script. pinging SI leads for integration dry-run on 9/22 morning.

sam-ops: Done — pre-reserve tentative slots in calendar (private) and I'll convert to firm reservations after Carl confirms hero list. calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.ai/r/secure/htJ2

deploy-bot: Lab reservation placeholders created (IDs: #lab-17495-A, #lab-17495-B, #lab-17495-C) — these expire in 48h unless confirmed.

kevin-sales: thanks. I'll sync with comms and draft embargo copy. also can someone add a short line about fallback model routing (hosted H100 vs B200 fallback) for the press engineers FAQ?

carl-partnerships: will add a sentence. final ask: everyone reply with ✅ if your area can commit to these dates (we'll finalize by EOD tomorrow).
